E1_ONE_CALL.purpose: End-to-end researcher from allowed raw study inputs

stage_boundaries.analyst: Produces structured analysis/evidence candidates; no story.
stage_boundaries.verifier: Checks estimand, universe, weight, routing, inference and claim support; may reject/repair candidates.
stage_boundaries.prioritiser: Selects and tiers supported findings; controls redundancy; no slide/layout decisions.
stage_boundaries.story_editor: Orders selected findings into renderer-neutral beats; cannot introduce new unsupported evidence.

run_validity: reference artifacts never included in model context
no ground-truth edits after first valid model run
